inventory_boundary.reason: The complete PDF was audited through Supplement Fig. S2 and the final page; there are no tables or external supplementary files.

acceptance_criteria: All 18 numerical axes are mapped to explicit relaxed or bulk-terminated slab work units with layer and observable semantics.

The runner internally implements the Wannier lattice Dyson equation, three/four-site DMFT fixed point, independent-chain CT-HYB aggregation, direct orbital spin-correlation sampling, FLL updates, MaxEnt/Pade continuation, layer projections, and charge-feedback loop.
Only the public plane-wave density-injection seam remains backend-specific, and execution fails closed when its unpublished projector convention or another indispensable input is absent.
No target becomes reproduced until full charge-self-consistent DFT+DMFT outputs, convergence evidence, exact input provenance, independent numerical cross-checks, and fresh review exist.

An independently chosen layered p-d model verifies the multi-site lattice Green function, FLL double counting, causal self-energy, spectral sum rule, layer projection, surface-energy formula, and imaginary-time symmetry.
The validation is method_validation_only and never substitutes for any NiO target axis.
The runner evaluates the printed symmetric-slab formula independently for both orientations once full-precision slab, matched bulk, area, and stoichiometry operands are supplied.
Missing operands produce an explicit blocked artifact; printed final surface energies are never reused as scientific inputs.
